# GENERATED FILE — do not edit by hand.
#
# Dependencies are declared once, in pyproject.toml. This file is the fully
# pinned resolution of those declarations, so CI, Replit and local installs all
# get byte-identical versions. Editing a version here without changing
# pyproject.toml will be silently reverted on the next regeneration.
#
# After changing dependencies in pyproject.toml, regenerate with:
#
#   uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra dev --universal \
#       --python-version 3.11 -o backend/requirements.txt
#
# The resolution is universal: markers cover Windows/Linux and Python 3.11+,
# so the same lock installs on a developer machine and on the 3.11 CI runner.
